reuse.why: The rule lives in the existing getScheduledAmount, the approximate tolerance reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules (the same one used for matching), and the new API field calls the helper.

duplication.why: The schedule-template midpoint copy is removed in favour of the helper and no new copy of the amount rule is introduced.

placement.why: The amount rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and the API field is a thin mapping in api-models.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Focused on the rule and the API field; the release note describes only the first step's rule and is now inaccurate.

maintainability.why: One definition with a named options object is easy to own, though several desktop-client callers (SchedulesTable, mobile list) still call it without op, so approximate amounts are treated differently there.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All server-side consumers and the API model call getScheduledAmount; no inline re-implementation.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the tolerance is shared with rule matching via getApproxNumberThreshold.

abstraction_drift.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount: positional inverse becomes an options object and gains op, with an isapprox branch that is part of the rule itself; no call site re-implements it (some desktop callers omit op).
